source: Claude Code JSONL session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<slug>/*.jsonl) and agenteval Agent Trace v1 files. Tolerant, streaming, redact-by-construction parse: no free text ever crosses into a RunRecord.

parse.schema_versions: collect every record.version into source.schemaVersions (sorted, unique)

regex.no-matches: no matches found|no files found|0 matches
regex.exit-nonzero: exit code [1-9]|exited with code [1-9]|non-?zero exit|command failed

LOOP.description: >= min_repeats tool calls with an identical (name, inputHash) AND identical resultHash inside a sliding window of `window` consecutive calls.

RETRY.description: >= min_consecutive_errors consecutive is_error results for one tool with no success between them.

APIERR.description: An assistant API-error record (isApiErrorMessage) or a system api_error event.

REFUSAL.description: An llm turn with a refusal stop reason, or a system model_refusal_* event.

DANGLE.description: A tool call that never received a result (evidence.atSessionEnd).

HOOKERR.description: A record carrying a non-empty hookErrors array.

TIMEOUT.description: A tool call that timed out (timedOut flag or error-class timeout).

TOOLERR.description: Per-tool error rate: a tool with >= min_calls calls and >= min_errors error results (reported separately, not in the headline).

DENIAL.description: A tool call denied by permission gating (reported separately).

INTERRUPT.description: A tool call interrupted mid-flight (reported separately).

COMPACT.description: The session hit a compaction boundary / carried a compaction summary (reported separately).

denominators.sessions: n = every JSONL file under the ingest dir at ingest time that has >= 1 assistant record; files with zero assistant records are counted (totalFiles) and excluded (excludedZeroAssistant), disclosed in run-meta, never padded.
denominators.tool_calls: every ToolCall across the included sessions.

headline_template: Across {sessions} of my own Claude Code sessions ({from} to {to}; {tool_calls} tool calls), {k} ({p}%, 95% Wilson CI {lo}-{hi}%) contain at least one pre-registered breakdown signature; the most frequent is {top_class} ({top_k} sessions); {err_calls} tool calls ({err_p}%, CI {err_lo}-{err_hi}%) returned an error.
not_measured: Silent wrong-output failures: there is no output-verification layer, so a session that finished with an incorrect answer but produced no error, loop, refusal, or dangle is NOT counted.
Subagent / sidechain transcripts that are absent from the ingest directory.
Anything that happened after ingest (later reruns, post-hoc edits, manual recovery).
